How it works (rule): Every load packet's phase voltages are stored (SiteLoadParameters). When at least 7 readings exist and ALL of the latest 5 have a phase above its maximum, the alarm is raised.
Default threshold: Site fields r/y/b_phase_voltage_threshold_max (only when Site.show_voltage_alarms is on). Auto mode: 253 V (230 V + 10 %).
How to configure: AlarmSetting (Django admin, per site + type): Auto / Manual (threshold) / Off, e-mail software team on/off, e-mail ground team on/off, repeat tolerance %. Manual = one voltage for all phases; empty = site phase fields.
Check timing / frequency: Real time, on every load packet
Repeat & e-mail rule: First occurrence e-mailed. Repeat: counted on the day's row at most every 30 min; e-mailed again only if > 5 % worse than the last e-mailed value (repeat tolerance). Next day with a similar value: no e-mail; after 24 h without the alarm it is new again.
E-mail recipients: wareApp/mqtt/services/alarm_recipients.py: SOFTWARE_TEAM (all sites) + GROUND_TEAM_ALL_SITES + LOCATION_TEAMS (by site location) + GROUND_TEAM (per site). Test server: ALARM_EMAIL_OVERRIDE_TO replaces them.
Frontend APIs that show it: alarmList/ (site summary), alarmListDetail/ (rows of one type), alarmTypeApi/ + alarmapi/ (super-admin active issues), snapshot/ (count)
